next_gate: Map every external provider, signature check, idempotency key, and privacy class.

contract_interfaces.api-gateway.http.proxy: carries provider-shaped paths only as an authenticated service passthrough
contract_interfaces.api-gateway.http.upstream: internal allow-listed upstream, not an external provider
contract_interfaces.api-gateway.event.request-completed: redacted telemetry, not an external provider
contract_interfaces.api-gateway.consumes.identity: internal platform dependency (planned), not an external provider

providers.name: LINE Messaging API (Official Account)

signature.scheme: HMAC-SHA256 over the exact raw body, base64 digest, constant-time compare
signature.gateway_verification: missing

gaps: events without webhookEventId or message.id are inserted without dedupe

replay_window.detail: no timestamp check; LINE event.timestamp is not validated, replay protection relies only on the event-id lookup

providers.privacy_evidence: solo-empire@981a12db:integrations/line/README.md:97-101 (--privacy-class restricted, retention customer-communications)

providers.name: Stripe webhooks

signature.scheme: Stripe v1: HMAC-SHA256 hex over `${t}.${rawBody}`, any v1 candidate, constant-time compare
signature.gateway_verification: missing

replay_window.detail: |now - t| <= 300 s on the signed timestamp

providers.privacy_evidence: raw payment event body is persisted verbatim (solo-empire@1d0e04bb:infra/api/server.ts:1079); payment events can carry customer contact and billing fields

providers.name: Analytics metrics push (internal caller, Bearer)

signature.scheme: none (Bearer token with api:write scope via generic /api/webhook/* guard)
signature.gateway_verification: bearer only (src/book_api_gateway/server.py:212-229)

idempotency.dedupe_store: asset_metrics upsert ON CONFLICT(asset_id, metric_date); totals updated by delta

replay_window.detail: no timestamp; replay converges because the upsert is idempotent per natural key

providers.privacy_evidence: aggregate per-asset counters only (views, subscribers, revenue, engagement_rate)

providers.name: Revenue record push (internal caller, Bearer)
